in_hebrew.name: Lynda
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lynda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'lyndos', meaning 'helpless' or 'light'. In Christianity, Lynda is associated with the virtues of kindness, faith, and loyalty. It's also believed to represent the gentle light of the Holy Spirit.
